messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets.
Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Use the medicine exactly as directed.
Take empagliflozin once a day in the morning, with or without food.
Your blood sugar will need to be checked often.
You may also need to test the level of ketones in your urine.
Empagliflozin can cause life-threatening ketoacidosis (too much acid in the blood).
Contact your doctor if a urine test shows that you have high ketones in the urine.
Even if your blood sugar is normal.
Blood sugar can be affected by stress, illness, surgery, exercise, alcohol use, or skipping meals.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia) can make you feel very hungry, dizzy, irritable, or shaky.
To quickly treat hypoglycemia, eat or drink hard candy, crackers, raisins, fruit juice, or non-diet soda.
Your doctor may prescribe glucagon injection in case of severe hypoglycemia.
You may get dehydrated during prolonged illness.
Call your doctor if you are sick with vomiting or diarrhea.
Triplet: ["empagliflozin", "has monitoring instruction", "check blood sugar often"]

The relation 'has monitoring instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires the specific monitoring or testing procedure specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
B. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are to be managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
C. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
E. 'has administration instruction': The subject drug should be taken or used in the manner specified by the object entity (for example with food or at a fixed time).
F. None of the above.

Answer:
